Use case: productivity-visual, a single editorial illustration asset for a widescreen presentation. Match a sophisticated architectural paper-craft series: sharply cut layered card, subtle paper fibers and internal occlusion, isometric mixed with a natural editorial perspective, warm ivory, dark petrol green, sage, and a small muted terracotta accent. Compose as one compact full silhouette in a landscape 3:2 frame with 12 percent clear margin on every side. Entire background and every space between objects must be truly transparent alpha. Objects have completely defined, crisp silhouettes. No fades, feathering, glow, halo, outline strokes, solid border, frame, backdrop, rectangular scene panel, drop shadow outside the silhouette, or floor beyond the objects. Do not print letters, numbers, labels, logos, glyphs, or typography.
A small dark-petrol open laptop on a low angle, with a simplified structural frame on its screen and two distinct, tactile miniature model fragments alongside it: ivory beams with a cut opening and a bent terracotta service duct. Keep the silhouette mostly made from the objects themselves, no enclosing support platform. A very focused still life about a simple new app and the two project models it needs.

One isolated isometric small-scale BIM architectural cutaway, an ivory structural concrete frame with clean orthogonal beams, floor slab with an obvious rectangular service opening, a pale sage wall strip, and a terracotta ventilation duct that passes through. Tactile architectural study model. Use clean plausible geometry, no grounds, no stage, no interface overlay, no exploded floating elements. Distinct dark petrol and sage supporting details give it an engineered feel.
